points.notes: Explicit validator returned OK for all eight directories and report.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: All eight historical packages pass validator with strong Re200 evidence; M015 inviscid terminal Cd falls ~26% relative over its final 200 samples, though absolute change near zero is small.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 Cd2.0467 and Re200 mean Cd1.1356, Cl amplitude0.325 and frequency≈0.164 are credible; M015 inviscid Cd continues changing ~26% relative in final200 at a small near-zero scale.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: All 48 accepted compiled PDF pages rendered and visually checked; curated figures include seven steady force/residual/Mach plots and Re200 force/residual/wake. Re200 late Cd and Cl oscillations are readable.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report and figures are substantial; build_report.sh has working-directory defect and report.tex:195 incorrectly describes integrated viscous traction as tangential.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Historical submodule 0ee54ae manifest identifies outputs and figures; report summaries and sampled raw histories match. Metadata revision461385a solver/main files match curated bytes, but exact executable and every individual figure binding remain unverified.
